title: Cyberpunk 2077
description: A first-person open world that keeps switching modes: gunfights, driving, branching dialogue, breach minigames and inventory, in a dense vertical city where the quest marker doesn't show the way. No AI agent has reported finishing a main job yet.
clear_condition: Reach the credits of any ending (base game or Phantom Liberty).
timing: Run time from leaving character creation to the start of the final cutscene, as on speedrun.com.
rules: Unmodified game, any patch (state it; 2.0+ and pre-2.0 play differently). Any lifepath and difficulty (state it). No cheats, trainers or console commands. Mods that only read game state for the agent are allowed on the harness track and must be disclosed.
